meta.notes: NOT YET POPULATED. Field widths and the font come from the form's XFA stream and must be extracted from the official PDF; do not estimate them. Research lead only, not data: the reference implementation AF-VCD/pdf-bullets vendors TimesNewRomanPSMT.ttf alongside a file named 12pt-times.json, which suggests Times New Roman at 12pt for this form. That is third-party inference, not a reading of the form, so it stays in this note until confirmed. Liberation Serif is metrically compatible with Times New Roman and is what /public/fonts ships.
